segments.name: Community Banking
segments.description: A New York metro community commercial bank providing personalized consumer and commercial banking products and services to local businesses, municipalities and individuals.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment, "Community Banking."

revenueModel.text: Deposit and loan customers pay the bank interest, fees and charges for banking services, deposits and lending.
